identity.life_stage: married, five grandchildren, retired school cook

engagement.interaction_backstory: She listens in the kitchen and in the car to the lake, and she found the catalog through a church newsletter. She plays the hymn-leaning albums and stops anything that starts building. She has never told anyone she listens, because in her congregation that would be a conversation.

depth.core_contradiction: The most generous woman in the county and physically unable to accept a casserole from anyone.
depth.wound: They lost the farm in the eighties and the whole family reorganized around not talking about it.
depth.longing: For one of the grandchildren to ask about the farm.
depth.faith_journey: Free Lutheran, plain, unfussy, deeply held; the emotional register of her faith is a quiet certainty and nothing else.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Oh, you bet"; says "different" when she means bad; understates everything.
depth.open_doubt: Whether God was in the eighties, and if so, what He was doing.

social_graph.note: drove truck thirty years; they can sit for an hour without speaking, happily
16; the only one who asks questions

depth.emotional_weather_default: Steady and mild; quiet in the dark months.
depth.daily_texture: The kitchen at six, the lake road, church potlucks, the freezer inventory, ice out in April.
depth.sensory_anchor: Norwegian hymns her grandmother sang while canning.
depth.living_arc: She wants to write the farm story down and thinks it would be putting on airs.
